must_fix_check.item: (should) F2 claws along the toe, varied sizes
must_fix_check.note: The claws now point forward out of the toe bumps and none passes the paw's side outline. Each paw still has four identical, evenly spaced cones.
az000: below the elbow the dark forearm is a straight post, as wide at the wrist as at the top.
The yellow shoulder stripe is gone, but no lighter chest plane reads in az000.
Each ear now has a lighter inset, but it is a square-cornered window (hero near ear, head close-up), not a cup.

must_fix_check.item: (should) O4 front paws under the hump
must_fix_check.note: az090: the forearm stands near vertical and the paw sits under the front of the hump.

issues.where: 1_beauty az000, forelegs; 2_closeups front limb colour
issues.what: From elbow to wrist the forearms are posts of constant section, ending in a wider box paw. They read as pillars in boots.
issues.fix: Stage 2: scale the wrist loop to about 80% width and flatten the forearm's front face. Leave the elbow where it is. IoU > 0.9.
issues.check: az000: each foreleg visibly narrows from elbow to wrist before the paw flares out.

issues.where: 1_beauty az000, both front paws; 2_closeups toes colour
issues.what: Each paw has four identical claw cones at equal spacing, so the row reads as a comb.
issues.fix: Stage 3, piece_claws: scale the outer two claws to 75% and the inner two to 110%. Fan them ±8° about the paw axis and sink each root 30% into its toe bump.
issues.check: az000 and the toes close-up: claw lengths visibly differ; hit 0.

issues.where: 1_beauty hero, near ear; 2_closeups head colour, both ears
issues.what: The inner-ear inset is a square tan window, not a rounded cup that follows the half-disc ear.
issues.fix: Stage 2: slide the inset's two outer corner verts inward about 30% so the inset follows the ear outline. Keep the tan paint.
issues.check: hero and az000: each ear shows a rounded lighter cup with no square corners.

issues.where: 1_beauty az000, chest between the forelegs
issues.what: With the stripe gone the chest is the same brown as the flank, so nothing marks the chest plane.
issues.fix: Stage 3: paint only the front-facing chest faces between the forelegs the body hue at +8% value, with no hue shift.
issues.check: az000: a lighter chest plane between the forelegs; az090 still reads one brown from cheek to elbow.

keep: az090: the shoulder hump is the highest point and the head is carried low, both in the base mesh
the face reads at thumbnail size: pale muzzle block, black nose pad, dark eyes with a glint, round ears
clean tech (hit, float, zfight, flip and drift all 0), with the eyes now riding the head through the attack

must_fix_check.note: No light outline along the mane border in the head close-up or the hero view; zfight and sliver 0.
az000: the mane still covers the whole neck. Its hem is near-straight with one notch on the image-left side, and no throat shows.
hero and az000: daylight between every tine and both ears; hit 0. The lowest tine now sits about 30% up the beam and points forward and up.
az090: a pale tab still breaks the rump outline. Hind close-up: a grey curled shell with a plate stands on the rump. back34: a disc plus a separate flap.
az000: no pale strokes beside the nose; az090 keeps the pale jaw line.
Front limb wire: still 5-6 evenly spaced loops per cannon, and the knee reads as a bead ring in colour.

issues.where: 2_closeups hind limb colour, top right (rump); 1_beauty az090, rump edge; 1_beauty back34, rump patch
issues.what: The tail still stands proud of the rump. At close range it is a grey curled scroll, with a flat plate sticking out at an angle. In az090 it breaks the rump outline as a pale tab. In back34 it is a cream flap beside the rump disc, with a dark notch between them. The heatmap is clean here because the tail neither floats nor intersects; the eye is right.
issues.fix: Stage 3: delete the curled shell and the side flap. Build the tail as one short flat wedge: about 8% of body length, thickness about 40% of its width, hanging on the centre line over the rump patch, root sunk 30%, cream underneath and brown on top. If the curl is body geometry, use stage 2 instead: move its verts onto the rump curve and flatten them into the patch, IoU > 0.9.
issues.check: az090: the rump outline is unbroken. back34: one cream patch with the tail hanging on the centre line. Hind close-up: no curled shell. hit 0, sliver 0.

issues.where: 1_beauty az000, neck; 1_beauty hero, throat
issues.what: From the front the mane covers the full neck width with a straight hem and a notch on one side only. In hero its front lip overlaps the throat as a flap.
issues.fix: Stage 3, piece_mane: scale the front 40% of the mane to 60% width about the centre line. Lift the front hem 10% of neck length into a centred V, and make the hem clumps symmetric about the centre.
issues.check: az000: body brown shows on both sides of a centred V bib, with no one-sided notch.

issues.where: 4_posed attack_f009 and f018, rack; 1_beauty hero; 2_closeups antlers colour
issues.what: The tines are identical straight cones at the same angle and even spacing along each beam, so the charging rack reads as a fishbone comb. Each tine root is a hard cone set on the beam with no node, and the beam keeps one section from base to crown.
issues.fix: Stage 3, piece_antlers: vary tine lengths 0.6-1.3× and angles by at least 15° from each other. Flare each root 1.3× and sink it 30% into the beam. Taper the beam 30% from base to crown.
issues.check: attack_f009: no two tines are parallel or equal in length. Head close-up: the tine roots blend into the beam. hit 0.

issues.where: 2_closeups front limb colour and wire; 1_beauty az000, legs
issues.what: 5-6 evenly spaced loops per cannon, and a bead ring at each knee and fetlock, read as bamboo segments.
issues.fix: Stage 2: dissolve every other cannon loop (logged). Flatten the knee ring so the knee is a flat-fronted block that bulges backward, not a ring.
issues.check: Front limb wire: at most 3 loops per cannon. Colour: no bead ring at the knee. IoU > 0.9.

ears clear of the rack in hero and az000 (hit 0), with a lyre spread of the beams in az000
the long tapered head with black nose and pale jaw line in profile, the warm red-brown palette and the dark mane collar with no rim outline

must_fix_check.note: flip is 2 (0.09%) and there is no purple at the hips, but in move_f012 the hop thigh still hangs from a thin neck at the hip.
sliver is 6 (was 34), with no yellow along the mouth in 3_tech.
attack_f016: a flat bar ending in a rounded pad, rooted at the mouth.
hero and the close-up: the gold now shades as a dome and the bevel ring is gone. az000: the pupils still sit on the top rim of each ball like black lids.
The light rims are gone, but the spots are still about 9 dark 4-sided parallelograms (back34).
The az000 belly reads light tan; the underside in the front-limb close-up is still brown.
back34 and the hind close-up: the web fills between the toes and no thin sheet edge shows.
triangles 2252 (was 2148); the head wire is still a dense shell.

issues.where: 4_posed move_f012, near hind leg at the hip
issues.what: At full hop extension the thigh hangs off the pelvis on a neck about 40% of the thigh's width, like a sausage on a string. The gauge passes (flip 2) because the faces thin without flipping; the eye is right.
issues.fix: Stage 4: spread the pelvis-to-thigh blend over the hip ring and one loop each side (70/30, 50/50, 30/70). Cut the thigh extension in move f010-f014 by about 20° and let the shin and foot carry the reach. If a neck remains, stage 2: log one loop at the hip and bind it 50/50.
issues.check: move_f012 wire: the hip section is at least 70% of the thigh's widest section; flip stays at 4 or below.

issues.where: 1_beauty az000, both eyes
issues.what: The pupils sit on the top rim of each gold ball. Face-on they read as black lids or a scowl, not pupils.
issues.fix: Stage 3: rotate piece_pupil and piece_glint about 20° down about each eye's lateral axis, so gold shows above and below each lozenge from the front. Keep them on the front half of the ball.
issues.check: az000: gold is visible above each pupil; hero: the pupil is still on the face of the ball.

issues.where: 1_beauty back34 and az090, back; 2_closeups hind limb colour
issues.what: The spots are about 9 dark 4-sided parallelograms of similar size in rows, so they read as windows or panels.
issues.fix: Stage 3: repaint 5-7 spots, each spanning 2-4 adjacent faces so its outline has 5 or more sides, in mixed sizes (1-2.5×) and not in rows.
issues.check: back34: 5-7 irregular spots, none a parallelogram.

issues.where: 2_closeups head wire and head colour; techqa triangles 2252
issues.what: The head is a dense triangulated shell, and its triangle count went up. The head top shows many small value shifts instead of big planes.
issues.fix: Stage 2: flatten() the brow, cheeks and back into 4-6 planes each, and dissolve the extra edges (logged).
issues.check: triangles 1800 or fewer; head colour shows big planes.

issues.where: 1_beauty az000, belly; 2_closeups front limb colour, underside
issues.what: The belly is khaki tan and turns brown in shadow instead of reading cream.
issues.fix: Stage 3: repaint the belly +12% value toward a warm cream, halfway to the toe-pad colour.
issues.check: az000: the belly reads cream; front-limb close-up: the underside is not brown.

hero: gold dome eyes on turrets with the horizontal lozenge pupil and glint, and the wide black mouth line over the cream jaw

issues.where: 1_beauty az090, top of the head
issues.what: The two tufts overlap into one tall, vertical dark spike that reads as a horn in profile.
issues.fix: Stage 2: rotate each tuft 15° back and 10° out about its root, and shorten it 15%.
issues.check: az090: two tuft tips angled back, neither vertical; az000 unchanged.

issues.where: 1_beauty az000, face and throat
issues.what: The facial disc is a cream rectangle with straight sides and dark square lower corners, cut off by a straight full-width throat band. It reads as a box face with a collar.
issues.fix: Stage 2: slide the disc-border verts on the two lowest cheek loops inward about 8% of head width to round the bottom of the disc. Stage 3: paint a dark rim along those loops and replace the band with a V bib under the beak.
issues.check: az000: a rounded disc outline with a dark rim and no full-width band; IoU > 0.9.

issues.where: 2_closeups head colour, near brow
issues.what: The brow is a thick dark plank laid on the face, and its underside and cast shadow show at close range.
issues.fix: Stage 3: sink piece_brow 40% of its thickness into the disc and bevel its lower edge into the face.
issues.check: Head close-up: no underside face visible under the brow; hit 0.

must_fix_check.note: hero and back34 colour: the crown shows a few big shell planes with no spoke or ring shading. The pole is still in the wire, but that check is waived.

az090: the lower segments are still long straight spikes standing as vertical stakes, with no second bend. The knees rise above the carapace and the body is about a third of its height off the ground.
back34: 5 cones with dark holes cluster on the rear edge and none sit on top, but they are still pale grey rings with visible bases.
move_f006 and move_f012 are near-identical, with no visible leg lift.

issues.where: 1_beauty az090, all walking legs; 1_beauty hero, right side; 1_beauty back34
issues.what: The walking legs are unchanged: long, straight, two-tone blades below a high knee, with no second bend. In az090 they stand as a row of vertical stakes with the knees above the carapace, holding the body a third of its height off the ground. In hero the four right legs are parallel spikes. From the side it reads as a harvestman.
issues.fix: Stage 2: slide the lower-segment loops to shorten each below-knee segment 25%, and move the verts at 65% of the segment outward about 10% of its length to make a second bend so the tip angles back in. Splay the front pair 20° forward and the rear pair 25° back. Stage 4: in every clip, lower the root 12% of body height and flex the knees outward. If the IoU floor blocks the stage-2 part, unlock stage 1 for leg length only and log it in NOTES.md: stage 4 alone keeps the stake shape, and leg length is what makes the side read as a spider.
issues.check: az090: every leg shows two angles, no knee is above the carapace top, and the underside is within 15% of body height of the ground. hero: the four right legs are not parallel.

issues.where: 1_beauty back34, rear edge of the carapace
issues.what: The barnacles now cluster and have holes, but they are pale grey rings with hard base edges, the highest-contrast detail on the crab after the claws.
issues.fix: Stage 3, piece_barnacles: tint 40% toward the shell's shadow red-grey, sink the bases a further 25%, and vary sizes 1-1.8×.
issues.check: back34: the cluster still reads, does not outcontrast the claws, and shows no base edge; float 0.

issues.where: 4_posed move_f006, f007, f012 and f013
issues.what: The move frames are near-identical, with no leg lift or body sway, so the walk will read as a slide.
issues.fix: Stage 4: key an alternating tetrapod gait, lifting the swing-set tips 15% of leg length, with a 3° body roll toward the stance side. Keep planted tips fixed in world space.
issues.check: Tip heights differ by at least 10% of leg length between f006 and f012, and planted tips do not move between consecutive frames.

chunky claws with a real gap between the fingers that snap in the attack
